# Founders Ramp
> A sales OS for founders and launch teams. Accelerate sales before hiring sellers.

Crunchbase: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/founders-ramp

Founders Ramp (no apostrophe) is taught by Justin Weller. Public door is a free 30-minute consultation. We are not their VP.

## Canonical
- [Approach](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/): Accelerate sales before hiring sellers
- [Self and team](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/self-team/): You still own it. Then someone else does.
- [Discovery](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/discovery/): Their week, not your deck
- [First call](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/first-call/): One live deal. Pass is allowed.
- [SCALE](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/scale/): The inspect, not the slogan
- [Inspection](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/inspection/): Watch the work
- [Books](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/books/): The books under the work
- [Equal commitment](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/equal-commitment.html): Match commitment or call the truth early
- [The first hire freezes the process](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/first-hire-freezes.html)
- [Product-led distribution is an oxymoron](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/product-distribution.html)
- [What are you measuring](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/what-are-you-measuring.html)
- [Language in business](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/language-in-business.html)
- [Library](https://www.foundersramp.net/briefing/): The public shelf
- [Book 30 minutes](https://cal.com/justin-weller-nsrjlg/30min)
